name: Zelophehad
bio: Zelophehad was the son of Hepher, of the tribe of Manasseh. Like most of his generation, he died in the wilderness, but Scripture specifically notes that he had no part in Korah's rebellion — he died for his own sin — and that he left no sons, only five daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah (Numbers 26:33; 27:3). His daughters later petitioned Moses over their father's inheritance, which led to a new law allowing daughters to inherit when there was no son; Zelophehad's name became attached to this landmark inheritance law (Numbers 27:1-11; 36:1-12).
